title: Virtual Desktop

licence.notes: The public GitHub repository is a release and changelog surface, not an open-source grant for the Virtual Desktop application or VDXR implementation. Do not copy implementation, binaries, substantial site content or compatibility data into Stephanos without permission.

public_capabilities: display a PC desktop, movies and flat games on a giant virtual screen
stream PCVR games from a Windows VR-ready PC to supported standalone headsets
present side-by-side 3D content using an in-app 3D mode
route compatible OpenXR games through VDXR or other supported runtimes
support multiple codecs, bitrate and streaming-quality controls
support gamepad, tracked-controller and selected hand/body/eye-tracking paths
publish compatibility and operational troubleshooting guidance
expose practical network, capture, DRM and black-screen limitations
promotion_rule: Use Virtual Desktop as an operational benchmark, presentation transport candidate and field-evidence source. Any Stephanos-owned reconstruction, streaming, runtime-routing or SBS system must be independently designed from open standards and licence-compatible components, then proven on the Battle Bridge and Quest 3.

trust.source_type: official commercial product and public release metadata
